title: Threshold parity size lower bound
statement: Let $n$ be a positive even integer, and let $s$ be a nonnegative integer. If the complete quadratic Boolean function on $n$ bits has a polynomial threshold representation with at most $s$ nonzero Fourier coefficients, then $2^{n/2}\le s$.
hypotheses_covered: the complete quadratic Boolean function has a polynomial threshold representation with Fourier support size at most $s$
